## Is Bitcoin Wealth right for me? An honest fit check

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/is-it-right-for-me/

Is Bitcoin Wealth right for you? Five honest questions, who it suits and who it does not, and where the money really comes from, before you spend anything.

### Is Bitcoin Wealth right for you?
An honest fit check before anything else. No pressure: not joining is a perfectly good answer.

#### Five honest questions

#### Tick what's true for you

#### Who it suits, and who it doesn't

##### It may suit you if
- You want to collect Bitcoin's value together with other people.
- You like a small, once-off start: 0.001 BTC plus network fees.
- You want payouts in your own wallet, with every payment public.
- You're willing to learn, share honestly and give it time.

##### It's probably not for you if
- You need this money for rent, food, school fees or debt.
- You're looking for a fixed or promised return.
- You won't introduce anyone. Two business partners switch on your progress.
- You'd pressure friends or family to join.

#### Where the money comes from
That's the whole money flow, in the open. No product, trading or mining is involved: payouts come from members activating slots, so they grow as the community grows.

## What is Bitcoin Wealth? Bitcoin, BTCB and the smart contract

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/what-is-bitcoin-wealth/

What is Bitcoin Wealth? A plain explanation of Bitcoin, BTCB, BNB Smart Chain and the smart contract that pays members wallet to wallet.

### What is Bitcoin Wealth?
A community way to collect Bitcoin's value. A smart contract on BNB Smart Chain takes each member's slot payment and sends it straight to other members' wallets, by fixed rules, in public.

#### Watch it in 3 minutes

##### It's not a coin. Here's what it is.
Thandi asks what everyone asks, and Leo answers in 3 minutes: Bitcoin, the smart contract, BTCB and BNB, where the money comes from, and how to check it yourself.
Thandi and Leo, and their voices, are made with AI. Prefer reading? Everything below says the same, in more detail.
- Video: Explainer 1, "What is Bitcoin Wealth?" (3:00): Thandi asks, Leo answers: Bitcoin Wealth is not a coin but a smart contract. Bitcoin, BTCB and BNB in plain words, where the money comes from, what it costs to start, and how to check every payment yourself. https://media.bitcoinwealthpays.com/videos/what-is-bitcoin-wealth-explained-in-3-minutes.mp4 Its own page, with every word in writing: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/explainers/what-is-bitcoin-wealth-video/

#### The idea in four moves
Tap a step to see it.
- 1 A member activates slot 1 They send 0.001 BTC worth of BTCB from their own wallet. Once.
- 2 The smart contract splits it Code on BNB Smart Chain follows fixed rules, in the same transaction.
- 3 It lands in a member's own wallet No withdraw button, no request, no office. It simply arrives.
- 4 Anyone can check it Every payment is public on BscScan, forever. Don't trust. Verify.

#### Four words that make it click

##### Bitcoin is the money
Bitcoin is digital money with no bank behind it. It started in January 2009, after the 2008 financial crisis. Only 21 million will ever exist, and every four years the halving cuts how many new ones are made. That's why people call it digital gold.

##### Bitcoin Wealth is a program
Bitcoin Wealth is not a coin. It's a smart contract: code that runs on BNB Smart Chain and moves Bitcoin's value between members by fixed rules. The engine is called Vow Unity.

##### BTCB is Bitcoin's value on BNB Smart Chain
The contract pays in BTCB, a token that tracks Bitcoin one to one and is backed by Bitcoin held by Binance. It is not Bitcoin on the Bitcoin network, but it can be swapped for Bitcoin.

##### BNB pays the fees
Every action on BNB Smart Chain costs a small network fee, paid in BNB. Keep a little BNB in your wallet, or nothing will move. Think of it as the postage stamp.

#### Bitcoin vs Bitcoin Wealth

##### Bitcoin
The money. Lives on its own blockchain. You can buy it, hold it and send it.

##### Bitcoin Wealth
A set of rules in code. It doesn't create Bitcoin. It moves members' BTCB from one wallet to another, the moment a slot is activated.

#### The whole plan, in 5 minutes

##### How Bitcoin Wealth works, in 5 minutes
Leo presents the whole thing, slide by slide: the idea, the smart contract, the 14 positions and the 12 slots.
The programme's own presentation, presented by Leo. Want the Bitcoin basics first? MTG's free Crypto 101 crash course has 15 short lessons.
- Video: Presentation, "How Bitcoin Wealth works" (5:20): The Bitcoin Wealth presentation in 5 minutes, presented by Leo: what it is, the Vow Unity smart contract, where the 14 positions of a cycle pay, the 12 slots, and where to get more information. https://media.bitcoinwealthpays.com/videos/how-bitcoin-wealth-works-presentation.mp4 Its own page, chapter by chapter: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/explainers/bitcoin-wealth-presentation/

## How Bitcoin Wealth works: the 14 positions explained

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/how-it-works/

How Bitcoin Wealth works: 14 positions in rows of 2, 4 and 8, where each of the 14 payments goes, and why nine of them point to you.

### How Bitcoin Wealth works: the 14 positions
Below you sit 2, then 4, then 8 positions: 14 in all. Each position is one member paying the slot price, and each one produces one payment. Here's where all fourteen go.

#### Watch it in 3 minutes

##### Thandi and Leo fill all 14 seats
Thandi asks who pays who. Leo fills the seats with her, row by row, until every payment has a place. 3:19.
- Where each of the 14 payments goes
- What changes from your second cycle
- Who fills the seats, and why there is no withdraw button
Explainer 2 of the Thandi and Leo series. Thandi and Leo, and their voices, are made with AI.
- Video: Explainer 2, "How the 14 positions pay" (3:19): Thandi asks, Leo draws it out seat by seat: 2, then 4, then 8 positions under you, where each of the 14 payments goes, the Royal Pool from your second cycle, who fills the seats, and why there is no withdraw button. https://media.bitcoinwealthpays.com/videos/how-bitcoin-wealth-pays-14-positions-explained.mp4 Its own page, with every word in writing: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/explainers/how-the-14-positions-pay-video/

#### Watch the positions fill
Then switch between the first cycle and later cycles.
14 positions: 2, then 4, then 8
Each position is one member paying the slot price, and each one produces one payment. Nine of the fourteen point to you: 6 to your wallet, 2 buy your next slot, 1 recycles you.

#### All fourteen, in one table

Where the 14 payments go
| Where the payment goes | First cycle | Later cycles |
|---|---|---|
| Your upline | 2 | 2 |
| Your wallet | 6 | 7 |
| Your next slot (first cycle) / Royal Pool (later) | 2 | 1 |
| Members below you | 3 | 3 |
| Recycle | 1 | 1 |
| Total | 14 | 14 |

From the programme's own presentation. Cycle 1: 2 to your upline, 6 to your wallet, 2 to your next slot, 3 to members below you, 1 recycles you. Later cycles: 7 to your wallet and 1 to the Royal Pool instead of the next slot.

#### Three things to remember

##### Nine point to you
6 to your wallet, 2 buy your next slot and 1 recycles you. That's why the programme says each slot can pay nine times its price.

##### No withdraw button
The contract splits each payment in the same transaction and sends it to the members' own wallets. You don't request anything.

##### Spillover
Positions below you can be filled by people you didn't introduce, when your upline's team overflows. It changes who fills a seat, not that someone has to.

#### Good to know

#### The presentation's part on it

## Bitcoin Wealth 12 slots and the 0.001 BTC once-off

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/12-slots/

The 12 Bitcoin Wealth slots from 0.001 BTC to 2.048 BTC, why the 0.001 BTC entry is a once-off, and what has to happen for auto entry.

### The 12 Bitcoin Wealth slots, and the once-off
Twelve slots, each double the one before, from 0.001 BTC to 2.048 BTC. You pay for slot 1 only. Every slot above it is bought for you from the cycle below, once that cycle fills.

#### Watch it in 3 minutes

##### Thandi asks who pays for slots 2 to 12
Leo shows her with two coins and one full cycle: why every slot is double, and why slot 1 is the only one you pay for. 3:14.
- Who pays for slot 2, and every slot after it
- What you actually pay: 0.001 BTC, once
- The one thing that has to happen to move up
Explainer 3 of the Thandi and Leo series. Thandi and Leo, and their voices, are made with AI.
- Video: Explainer 3, "The 12 slots and the once-off" (3:14): Thandi asks who pays for slots 2 to 12, and Leo shows it with two coins and one full cycle: 12 slots, each double the one before, slot 1 the only one you pay for, and what has to happen to move up. https://media.bitcoinwealthpays.com/videos/bitcoin-wealth-12-slots-why-you-only-pay-once.mp4 Its own page, with every word in writing: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/explainers/the-12-slots-video/

#### Every slot, side by side
From the programme's own presentation. Slot 1 is a plain entry. Slots 2 to 12 are marked Auto Entry: each is bought with two of the fourteen payments from your first cycle at the slot below. The full ladder totals 4.095 BTC.

#### What it costs you

##### Your own outlay
0.001 BTC plus network fees. That's it. You never pay again to move up the slots. MTG's point: it's a once-off, not a subscription.

##### What moves you up
Auto entry buys slot 2 when your slot 1 cycle fills with 14 members. Your first two business partners and spillover from above fill it.

#### In the presentation

## Bitcoin Wealth recycling and the Royal Pool explained

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/recycling-royal-pool/

What changes after your first cycle in Bitcoin Wealth: recycling, seven payments to your wallet, and the Royal Pool for slot 3 qualifiers.

### Bitcoin Wealth recycling and the Royal Pool
When a cycle completes, one payment puts you back into the same slot, so it can pay again. From your second cycle at a slot, the split changes slightly.

#### First cycle vs later cycles
Switch to Later cycles: your next slot is already bought, so one payment moves to your wallet and one to the Royal Pool.
14 positions: 2, then 4, then 8
Each position is one member paying the slot price, and each one produces one payment. Nine of the fourteen point to you: 6 to your wallet, 2 buy your next slot, 1 recycles you.

#### Two ideas, plainly

##### Recycling
Position 14 places you at the bottom of a fresh cycle at the same slot. The programme says there's no limit on recycles and no expiry on slots.

##### The Royal Pool
In later cycles, one payment goes to the Royal Pool, held in the contract. Members who reach slot 3 and qualify by the 21st share it on the last day of the month.

## Bitcoin Wealth vs a stokvel: the honest comparison

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/stokvel/

Bitcoin Wealth compared with a stokvel: where it wins (transparency, own wallet, no bank) and the one place the comparison honestly stops.

### Is Bitcoin Wealth better than a stokvel?
Stokvels are trusted by millions of South Africans, and for good reason. Bitcoin Wealth shares the spirit: ordinary people pooling, no bank in the middle. Here's where it does better, and how each one is funded.

#### Watch it in 4 minutes

##### Thandi asks if it's just a stokvel on the internet
Leo answers the six questions on this page side by side, and shows where the stokvel picture stops. 3:56.
- Who holds the money, and who can see every payment

Thandi and Leo, and their voices, are made with AI.
- Video: Explainer 4, "Better than a stokvel?" (3:56): Thandi asks if Bitcoin Wealth is just a stokvel on the internet, and Leo answers six honest questions side by side: who holds the money, who can see the payments, the fees, what it pays in, how much you put in, and whether your turn is guaranteed. https://media.bitcoinwealthpays.com/videos/bitcoin-wealth-vs-stokvel-6-questions-side-by-side.mp4 Its own page, with every word in writing: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/explainers/better-than-a-stokvel-video/

#### Side by side

#### The verdict

##### Where Bitcoin Wealth wins
- Transparency: every payment public, nobody has to be trusted to report it
- Peer to peer: payouts go straight to members' wallets
- No middleman holding the pot, no bank charges
- One small entry instead of monthly contributions
- Priced in Bitcoin's value, not rand

##### How each one is funded
- A stokvel is a closed circle: the same members take turns with the same pot
- Bitcoin Wealth is open: each cycle is completed by members activating the positions below you
- So it grows as the community grows, which is why teaching others matters

## What makes Bitcoin Wealth different: the 5-point check

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/what-makes-it-different/

What makes Bitcoin Wealth different from newer copycat platforms, and the five checks you can run on any smart contract platform yourself.

### What makes Bitcoin Wealth different
New smart contract platforms appear all the time, many of them copies with a new name. We don't name them. We give you five checks that work on any of them, and show how Bitcoin Wealth does on each.

#### What Bitcoin Wealth gets right
Members who tried the newer, shinier platforms keep coming back, MTG included. These are the reasons, and every one can be checked.

##### Paid to your own wallet
No dashboard balance, no withdraw button, nobody to ask. Payouts land in the wallet only you control.

##### One entry, once
0.001 BTC activates slot 1. You never pay again to move up: slots 2 to 12 are bought from the cycle below, once it fills.

##### Every payment public
The contract and every transaction sit on BNB Smart Chain. Open BscScan and look for yourself.

##### Priced in Bitcoin
Slots and payouts are in BTCB, Bitcoin's value on BNB Smart Chain. Not points, not a made-up coin.

##### No bank, no treasurer
No bank in the middle and no treasurer holding the pot in a personal account. Code follows the same rules for everyone.

##### People, not just code
Live Zoom five evenings a week, in four languages, plus a WhatsApp community that answers questions.

#### The 5-point check
- 1. How long has it been running? Bitcoin Wealth's contract has been on chain since April 2026, with 41,013 member IDs by 14 November 2026. Ask the same of any newer platform.
- 2. Is the contract public? Open the address on BscScan. You can read the transactions, the token transfers and the contract itself.
- 3. Who holds the money? In Bitcoin Wealth, slot payments go straight to members' own wallets in the same transaction. A platform where money sits in a dashboard balance is a different design.
- 4. Can an admin change the rules or move funds? Be honest about this one. Bitcoin Wealth's contract has an owner wallet with an emergency withdrawal for what the contract holds. Check every platform for the same.
- 5. Can you see real payments? Yes: every activation and every payout is a public transaction. If a platform can't show you this, walk away.

#### Why that matters

##### The original
MTG calls Bitcoin Wealth the original: priced in Bitcoin, paid wallet to wallet, open on BscScan, and still running. 41,013 member IDs say people keep choosing it.

##### Don't trust. Verify.
You don't have to believe MTG or anyone else. Every claim on this page can be checked in a few minutes. Here's how.

## Bitcoin Wealth contract on BscScan: check it yourself

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/check-it-yourself/

The Bitcoin Wealth contract address, what BscScan shows today, how to read a real payment, and the admin controls in the code, checked on chain.

### Check Bitcoin Wealth yourself
Don't take anyone's word for it, including MTG's. Bitcoin Wealth runs on a public blockchain, so you can look at the contract and every payment yourself. Here's what we found, and how to find it.

#### The address
Tip: type it into bscscan.com yourself rather than trusting a link someone sends you.

#### What the blockchain showed
Read directly from BNB Smart Chain on 14 November 2026 (13 Nov 22:55 to 14 Nov 13:55 UTC for the payment sample). The other 17 stayed in the contract, which is where the Royal Pool is held.

#### Four steps, five minutes
- Open the contract on BscScan Paste the address into bscscan.com. The Transactions tab lists every activation.
- Open one recent transaction Look at "ERC-20 Tokens Transferred". One activation of 0.001 BTCB shows the payment going on to a member's wallet in the same transaction.
- Check the Token Holdings The contract holds some BTCB: that's the Royal Pool waiting for its monthly payout.
- Read the Contract tab Look for functions only the owner can use. Knowing them is part of doing your own research.

#### The full picture

## How to join Bitcoin Wealth with SafePal, step by step

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/join/

Join Bitcoin Wealth step by step: set up SafePal, buy BNB on VALR or Binance, swap to BTCB, then activate slot 1 with the sign-up link.

### How to join Bitcoin Wealth, step by step
Three stages, five steps, from an empty phone to slot 1. Take them one at a time, and watch the tutorial for each before you tap anything.

#### Before you start

##### What you need
- A smartphone with the SafePal app
- 0.001 BTC worth of BTCB, plus a little extra
- A little BNB for network fees
- A VALR or Binance account to buy with rand
- The sign-up link of the person who introduced you
On the recording day of Tutorial 1, Bitcoin was about $67,000, so 0.001 BTC was about $67. With fees and a little BNB, MTG suggested preparing about $76, about R1,300. Prices move every minute: check today's price in rand.
- Video: Tutorial 1, "Set up your SafePal wallet for Bitcoin Wealth" (7:25): Download SafePal from the official site, create a wallet, back it up two ways, and keep only BNB, USDT and BTCB. https://media.bitcoinwealthpays.com/videos/bitcoin-wealth-tutorial-1-safepal-wallet-setup.mp4 Its own page, with every step in writing: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/tutorials/safepal-wallet-setup/

#### The five steps
- Set up SafePal Download SafePal from safepal.com, create a wallet, back it up two ways and keep only BNB, USDT and BTCB. Tutorial 1 shows every tap.
- Open a VALR or Binance account Both let you buy crypto with rand. Many members keep both, as a backup.
- Buy BNB and send it to SafePal Buy enough BNB for 0.001 BTC plus fees, then withdraw it to your SafePal BNB address on BNB Smart Chain (BEP20), and check the first and last characters of the address. Tutorial 2 shows every tap.
- Swap BNB to BTCB in SafePal Swap a little more than you need (type 0.0011 BTCB), and keep some BNB for network fees. Never empty your BNB. Tutorial 3 shows every tap.
- Activate slot 1 Copy the sign-up link, paste it into SafePal's Explore tab, choose BNB Chain, check the referrer, then confirm twice in your wallet. Tutorial 3 shows every tap.

#### Fund your SafePal

##### Tutorial 2: Buy BNB on VALR and send it to SafePal
Steps 2 and 3, tap by tap. Send rand from your bank to VALR with your own reference, buy BNB with it, and send the BNB to your SafePal wallet on BNB Smart Chain.
- Pay by EFT from a bank account in your own name
- Type your VALR reference exactly as VALR shows it: it is how VALR knows the money is yours
- Buy BNB with your rand
- Withdraw to your SafePal BNB (BEP20) address on BNB Smart Chain, and check the first and last characters
- Video: Tutorial 2, "Buy BNB on VALR and send it to SafePal" (5:57): Send rand from your bank to VALR with your own reference, buy BNB with it, and send the BNB to your SafePal wallet on BNB Smart Chain. https://media.bitcoinwealthpays.com/videos/bitcoin-wealth-tutorial-2-buy-bnb-send-to-safepal.mp4 Its own page, with every step in writing: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/tutorials/buy-bnb-send-to-safepal/

#### Swap, sign up, activate slot 1

##### Tutorial 3: Swap BNB for BTCB, sign up and activate slot 1
Steps 4 and 5, tap by tap. Swap BNB for BTCB in SafePal, sign up with the link of the person who invited you, activate slot 1 with two confirmations, and get back into your dashboard any time.
- Swap a little more than you need: type 0.0011 BTCB, so a little over 0.001 arrives
- Keep some BNB in your wallet for network fees
- On the registration page, check the referrer: it is the member ID of the person who invited you
- Your wallet asks twice: Approve, then Confirm again. Approve only the exact 0.001 BTC
The button copies MTG's sign-up link. Introduced by someone else? Use their link, so they stay your sponsor.
- Video: Tutorial 3, "Swap BNB for BTCB, sign up and activate slot 1" (6:10): Swap BNB for BTCB in SafePal, sign up with the link of the person who invited you, activate slot 1 with two confirmations, and get back into your dashboard any time. https://media.bitcoinwealthpays.com/videos/bitcoin-wealth-tutorial-3-swap-bnb-to-btcb-activate-slot-1.mp4 Its own page, with every step in writing: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/tutorials/swap-bnb-to-btcb-activate-slot-1/

## Bitcoin Wealth tutorial videos: join step by step

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/tutorials/

Three step-by-step Bitcoin Wealth tutorial videos by MTG: set up SafePal, buy BNB with rand, swap to BTCB and activate slot 1. Every tap shown.

### Bitcoin Wealth tutorial videos
Three step-by-step videos take you from an empty phone to slot 1. Recorded on MTG's own phone, with every private detail hidden. Pause after each step and do it yourself.

#### Tutorial 1: Set up your SafePal wallet for Bitcoin Wealth
Download SafePal from the official site, create a wallet, back it up two ways, and keep only BNB, USDT and BTCB.
- Download from safepal.com, never from a link in a message
- Two backups: Google Drive and paper
- Rename the wallet Bitcoin Wealth
- Keep only BNB (BEP20), USDT (BEP20) and BTCB (BEP20)
- Video: Tutorial 1, "Set up your SafePal wallet for Bitcoin Wealth" (7:25): Download SafePal from the official site, create a wallet, back it up two ways, and keep only BNB, USDT and BTCB. https://media.bitcoinwealthpays.com/videos/bitcoin-wealth-tutorial-1-safepal-wallet-setup.mp4 Its own page, with every step in writing: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/tutorials/safepal-wallet-setup/

#### Tutorial 2: Buy BNB on VALR and send it to SafePal
Send rand from your bank to VALR with your own reference, buy BNB with it, and send the BNB to your SafePal wallet on BNB Smart Chain.
- Pay by EFT from a bank account in your own name
- Type your VALR reference exactly as VALR shows it: it is how VALR knows the money is yours
- Buy BNB with your rand
- Withdraw to your SafePal BNB (BEP20) address on BNB Smart Chain, and check the first and last characters
Using Binance instead? The steps are very similar.
- Video: Tutorial 2, "Buy BNB on VALR and send it to SafePal" (5:57): Send rand from your bank to VALR with your own reference, buy BNB with it, and send the BNB to your SafePal wallet on BNB Smart Chain. https://media.bitcoinwealthpays.com/videos/bitcoin-wealth-tutorial-2-buy-bnb-send-to-safepal.mp4 Its own page, with every step in writing: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/tutorials/buy-bnb-send-to-safepal/

#### Tutorial 3: Swap BNB for BTCB, sign up and activate slot 1
Swap BNB for BTCB in SafePal, sign up with the link of the person who invited you, activate slot 1 with two confirmations, and get back into your dashboard any time.
- Swap a little more than you need: type 0.0011 BTCB, so a little over 0.001 arrives
- Keep some BNB in your wallet for network fees
- On the registration page, check the referrer: it is the member ID of the person who invited you
- Your wallet asks twice: Approve, then Confirm again. Approve only the exact 0.001 BTC
- Video: Tutorial 3, "Swap BNB for BTCB, sign up and activate slot 1" (6:10): Swap BNB for BTCB in SafePal, sign up with the link of the person who invited you, activate slot 1 with two confirmations, and get back into your dashboard any time. https://media.bitcoinwealthpays.com/videos/bitcoin-wealth-tutorial-3-swap-bnb-to-btcb-activate-slot-1.mp4 Its own page, with every step in writing: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/tutorials/swap-bnb-to-btcb-activate-slot-1/
Do I really need to watch them all?
Yes, even if you think you already know. Each one shows a screen you'll meet sooner or later. Then share them: we learn best when we teach others.

## How to set up SafePal for Bitcoin Wealth: Tutorial 1

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/tutorials/safepal-wallet-setup/

Video and written steps: download SafePal from the official site, create your wallet, back it up two ways and keep only BNB, USDT and BTCB.

### How to set up your SafePal wallet for Bitcoin Wealth
Tutorial 1 of 3. Download SafePal from the official site, create a brand new wallet, back it up two ways, and keep only the three coins Bitcoin Wealth needs. Watch it, then follow every step in writing below.

#### Watch the video
- Video: Tutorial 1, "Set up your SafePal wallet for Bitcoin Wealth" (7:25): Download SafePal from the official site, create a wallet, back it up two ways, and keep only BNB, USDT and BTCB. https://media.bitcoinwealthpays.com/videos/bitcoin-wealth-tutorial-1-safepal-wallet-setup.mp4 Its own page, with every step in writing: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/tutorials/safepal-wallet-setup/

#### In this video
- Download the official SafePal app 0:44
- Back up your wallet, two ways 1:54
- Clean up your wallet 4:00
- What it costs to start 5:04
Tap a time to start the video at that part. It plays in a phone frame and closes itself at the end.
No VALR or Binance account yet? Open one now, so it is verified by the time you reach Tutorial 2.

#### Every step, in writing
The words MTG says in the video, step by step. Tap a time to watch that step.

##### Welcome
Hi, my name is MTG, Your Digital Architect. Thank you for taking the time to watch this video.
In this video, I'll show you how to set up your SafePal wallet for Bitcoin Wealth, step by step, on your phone. We'll download the official app, create a brand new wallet, and back it up two ways. Then we'll clean it up, so it shows only the three coins you need. And I'll show you what it costs to get started. Take your time. You can pause any step and follow along with me.
- Why a Web3 wallet? 0:26 Why a Web3 wallet? A Web3 wallet is an app where you hold your own crypto, with your own keys. No bank, no company and no admin holds it for you. Bitcoin Wealth pays wallet to wallet, straight into yours. In this video, we use SafePal. Other Web3 wallets, like MetaMask, work too.

##### Part 1 Download the official SafePal app
- Leo, the mascot: First, download the official app. Only from safepal.com.
- 1 Go to safepal.com 0:52 Open your browser and go to safepal.com, the official website. Always download apps from the official website, never from a link someone sends you. Scroll down, and tap Download App.
- 2 Get it on Google Play 1:03 On Android, tap Get it on Google Play. On iPhone, tap App Store.
- 3 Check it, then Install 1:08 Before you install, check two things: the developer, SafePal Wallet, and more than 5 million downloads. That's how you know it's the real app. Then tap Install.
- 4 Decline offer, then Open 1:17 If Google Play shows you an offer, tap Decline offer. Stay focused. When it's done, tap Open.
- 5 Create New Wallet 1:23 Tap Create New Wallet. We're making a brand new wallet, just for Bitcoin Wealth.
- 6 Set your 6-digit password 1:28 Create a 6-digit password, then type it again to confirm. It unlocks SafePal on this phone.
- 7 Your Wallet is Ready! 1:33 Your wallet is ready. Read this with me: Secure your wallet by saving your mnemonic phrase. This unique set of words is your only key to access your funds. SafePal cannot store or recover it for you. Your mnemonic phrase is your 12 secret recovery words. Whoever has them, has your wallet. This is the most important part of this video, so save it now. It'll be here when you do it yourself.

##### Part 2 Back up your wallet, two ways
- Leo, the mascot: Now back it up, two ways. Never skip this.
- 8 Back Up Now 2:00 Tap Back Up Now. Never skip this. There are two ways to back up, and we'll do both.
- 9 Back up to Google Drive 2:05 First, Back up to Google Drive. Choose your Google account, then enter your 6-digit password.
- 10 Create a backup password 2:11 Now create a backup password. Easy for you to remember, hard for anyone to guess: at least 8 characters, with letters and numbers. Only tap the eye if nobody is around you. SafePal can't reset this password, so write it down. Your backup file is encrypted on your phone. Encrypted means locked with your password, so nobody can read it without it. Then it goes to your Google Drive. SafePal doesn't keep a copy. Tap Next.
- 11 Read, tick, Start Backup 2:34 Read these before you tick them. The backup password is not your wallet password. It only restores your wallet from cloud storage, which means your Google Drive, online. It can't be changed or recovered. If you lose it, you can't restore from Google Drive. Tick all three, and tap Start Backup.
- 12 First backup: done 2:50 Done. Your first backup is safe.
- 13 Name it: Bitcoin Wealth 2:53 Now give your wallet a clear name. Tap the wallet name at the top, then the three dots next to your wallet, and the pencil. Type Bitcoin Wealth, and tap Confirm.
- 14 Never share your private key 3:02 On this page you'll also see Export Private Key. Never share your private key with anyone. Like your 12 words, it opens your wallet.
- 15 Back up manually 3:10 Now the second backup, on paper. Tap Backup, then Back up manually. Read these three: losing your mnemonic phrase means losing your assets for good. Deleting the app deletes the wallet data. And back up somewhere private, with no person and no camera around you. Tick them, tap Understood, and enter your 6-digit password.
- Write your 12 words on paper 3:29 SafePal now shows your 12 words, and it hides this screen from recordings, to protect you. Write the 12 words on paper, in order, and keep them offline. Never take a screenshot, never copy them, never store them online, and never send them to anyone. Then tap Next, and tap the words in the same order, to prove you wrote them down correctly. Made a mistake? Clear them and try again. When they're right, tap Verify.
- 16 Backup completed 3:52 Backup completed. Two green ticks: Google Drive, and manual. Well done. Most people skip this part, and you didn't.

##### Part 3 Clean up your wallet
- Leo, the mascot: Now, clean up your wallet. You only need three coins.
- 17 Manage Coins: keep BNB 4:07 Now let's clean up your wallet, so it shows only what Bitcoin Wealth needs. On the wallet home, tap the three dots next to Search, then Manage Coins. Turn off every coin except BNB, BEP20. BNB pays the small network fees, called gas.
- 18 Add USDT and BTCB (BEP20) 4:22 Tap the plus, search USDT, and turn on USDT, BEP20. BEP20 means it runs on BNB Smart Chain, Binance's blockchain. Then search BTC, and turn on BTCB, BEP20.
- What is BTCB? 4:36 BTCB is Bitcoin's value on BNB Smart Chain. It follows the price of Bitcoin one to one, and it's what Bitcoin Wealth runs on.
- 19 3 coins: BNB, BTCB, USDT 4:45 Back on the wallet home, you should see just three coins: BNB, BTCB and USDT. If yours looks like mine, comment DONE.
- For builders: a website like this one 4:53 Builders, a website like this one, with your own name and your links, does the explaining for you. BW stands for Bitcoin Wealth, and you can order yours at mtgtribe.com/bwcopy.

##### Part 4 What it costs to start
- Leo, the mascot: So, what does it cost to start?
- 20 Bitcoin on 14 Nov 2026 5:08 So what does it cost to get started? I checked on CoinGecko on 14 November 2026. Bitcoin was about $67,200. The minimum to start Bitcoin Wealth is 0.001 Bitcoin, 1 thousandth of a Bitcoin. That was about $67. And the 0.001 is a once-off. You never pay again to move up to the next slots.
- 21 About R1,300 to start 5:30 That day, $1 was about R16.98. I'd prepare about $76, around R1,300. That covers the 0.001, the fees from your bank to VALR, and from VALR to SafePal, and a little BNB for gas. No VALR or Binance account yet? Tap the buttons below this video to open one. I use both. It's smart to have a backup, just like having more than one income stream.
- Prices change every day 5:54 Prices change every day. The entry is fixed in Bitcoin, so when Bitcoin is lower, you need fewer rands to start, and when it's higher, you need more.
- Ready to join? 6:02 Ready to join? If I invited you, go to mtgtribe.com/bw. If someone else invited you, use their link, so you join their team.
- Live on Zoom 6:11 We meet live on Zoom 5 evenings a week, in 4 languages. Ask the person who invited you to add you to the WhatsApp group, or tap the WhatsApp button below this video.

##### Recap
Let's recap what we covered in this video. We downloaded the official SafePal app. We created a brand new wallet. We backed it up two ways, on Google Drive and on paper. And we cleaned it up to show BNB, BTCB and USDT.

##### Next video
In the next video, part 2, I'll show you how to fund your SafePal wallet with BNB, and swap it for BTCB, ready for Bitcoin Wealth.

##### One more thing
And remember: everyone needs their own copy. mtgtribe.com/bwcopy.

This video is for every team, so feel free to share it. Save this video, so it's here when you need it. Share it with someone who's ready to start. We learn best when we teach others. It pays to pay attention, and take action. Quick reminder: none of this is financial advice. Always do your own research. Thank you for tuning in, and for every like, share, and comment. ## Buy BNB on VALR and send it to SafePal: Tutorial 2

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/tutorials/buy-bnb-send-to-safepal/

Video and written steps: send rand from your bank to VALR with your own reference, buy BNB, and send it to SafePal on BNB Smart Chain.

### How to buy BNB on VALR and send it to SafePal
Tutorial 2 of 3. Send rand from your bank to VALR with your own reference, buy BNB with it, and send that BNB to your SafePal wallet on BNB Smart Chain. Watch it, then follow every step in writing below.

#### Watch the video
- Video: Tutorial 2, "Buy BNB on VALR and send it to SafePal" (5:57): Send rand from your bank to VALR with your own reference, buy BNB with it, and send the BNB to your SafePal wallet on BNB Smart Chain. https://media.bitcoinwealthpays.com/videos/bitcoin-wealth-tutorial-2-buy-bnb-send-to-safepal.mp4 Its own page, with every step in writing: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/tutorials/buy-bnb-send-to-safepal/

#### In this video
- Deposit rand into VALR 0:22
- Buy BNB 2:40
- Send your BNB to SafePal 3:05
Tap a time to start the video at that part. It plays in a phone frame and closes itself at the end.
Both exchanges let you buy crypto with rand. Many members keep both, as a backup.

#### Every step, in writing
The words MTG says in the video, step by step. Tap a time to watch that step.

##### Welcome
Hi, my name is MTG, Your Digital Architect. Thank you for taking the time to watch this video.
In this video, I'll show you how to send rand from your bank to VALR, buy BNB with it, and send that BNB to your SafePal wallet. Using Binance instead? The steps are very similar. Take your time. You can pause any step and follow along with me.

##### Part 1 Deposit rand into VALR
- Leo, the mascot: First, let's get your rand into VALR!
- 1 Assets, then Rand 0:28 Open the VALR app and tap Assets, at the bottom right. Under Cash and stablecoins, tap Rand. Can't see it? Tap Search and type rand.
- 2 Deposit, Fiat, ZAR 0:37 Your rand wallet has three buttons: Buy and sell, Deposit and Withdraw. Tap Deposit. Keep Fiat deposit, with ZAR as the currency, and tap the arrow next to Method.
- 3 Method: EFT 0:48 Choose EFT, a normal transfer from your bank. That's the one I recommend.
- 4 Read the notes 0:53 Read these notes. VALR only accepts EFT payments from a bank account in your own name. No cash and no cheques. Don't deposit the same amount more than once a day. And a deposit can take up to 2 business days to reflect.
- 5 Your reference number 1:06 Below that are VALR's bank details at Standard Bank. And at the bottom, your reference number. Every VALR customer has their own reference. It's how VALR knows the money is yours. Leo, the mascot: Look here, this one's important.
- 6 Open your banking app 1:19 Copy the details, then open your banking app. I use FNB. Your bank may hide some screens while you record, so parts of my screen go dark. That's normal.
- 7 Pay, then pick VALR 1:29 Tap Pay, then Pay again. The first time, choose Once-off payment, paste VALR's details, and save VALR as a recipient, so next time there's nothing to copy. I saved it already, so I just pick VALR Crypto Exchange.
- 8 How much? About R1,300 1:42 How much? The only slot you ever pay for is slot 1: 0.001 Bitcoin. On 15 November 2026, Bitcoin was about $65,300 on CoinGecko, so 0.001 was about $65. To cover the fees, I send about $76, R1,300.
- 9 Your reference, exactly 2:03 Now the most important part. Type your reference exactly as VALR shows it, and check the account number. FNB asks for the reference twice. One wrong letter, and your money can't find your VALR account. Leo, the mascot: That reference number is everything!
- Tick Real-time payment 2:18 Tick Real-time payment, so the money arrives in minutes, not days. Your bank may charge a small fee for it. Then tap Pay.
- 10 Please confirm 2:26 Check the Please confirm screen: VALR Crypto Exchange, Standard Bank, the amount and your reference. Tap Confirm, then Finish.
- 11 The rand arrived 2:34 Back in VALR, tap Back, then Assets. There it is. My rand arrived within minutes, on a Sunday.

##### Part 2 Buy BNB
- Leo, the mascot: Now, let's buy BNB!
- 12 Trade, then Buy & Sell 2:46 Tap Trade, in the middle at the bottom, then Buy and sell.
- 13 Buy BNB, pay with ZAR 2:49 Keep Buy. It says buy BTC, pay with ZAR. Tap the arrow next to BTC and choose BNB.
- 14 Max, Review, Swipe 2:57 Tap Max to use all your rand, then Review order. Check it, and swipe to confirm.
- 15 Order completed 3:02 Order completed. Tap View BNB wallet.

##### Part 3 Send your BNB to SafePal
- Leo, the mascot: Almost there!
- 16 Withdraw, copy from SafePal 3:08 Tap Withdraw. VALR needs your SafePal address. Open SafePal, tap Receive, choose BNB, BEP20, and tap Copy.
- 17 Paste, BNB Smart Chain 3:18 Back in VALR, paste it. Check that the network says Binance Smart Chain, the same as BNB Smart Chain. Tap Use all, then Next. Leo, the mascot: Double check this.
- 18 Self-hosted wallet 3:30 VALR asks who you're sending to. Choose Individual, and type your own name, because it's your own wallet. Under Wallet, choose Self-hosted wallet. Tick the box, and tap Next. Leo, the mascot: Self-hosted means your own wallet.
- 19 Check the address 3:45 Check the address. The first few and the last few characters must match your SafePal address. Then tap Confirm withdrawal.
- 20 Approve by email 3:53 VALR emails you a link to approve it. Open the email, tap Authorise transaction, and enter the code from your authenticator app.
- 21 Withdrawal request received 4:00 Withdrawal request received. Tap Close.
- 22 BNB arrived in SafePal 4:03 Open SafePal and refresh. My BNB arrived: about $79 worth, a little more than 0.001 Bitcoin. If yours arrived too, comment DONE.
- 23 VALR and Binance: have both 4:14 No VALR or Binance account yet? Tap the buttons below this video to open one. I use both. It's smart to have a backup, just like having more than one income stream.
- For builders: a website like this one 4:24 Builders, a website like this one, with your own name and your links, does the explaining for you. BW stands for Bitcoin Wealth, and you can order yours at mtgtribe.com/bwcopy.
- Live on Zoom 4:36 We meet live on Zoom 5 evenings a week, in 4 languages. Ask the person who invited you to add you to the WhatsApp group, or tap the WhatsApp button below this video.

##### Recap
Let's recap what we covered in this video. We sent rand from our bank to VALR, with our own reference. We bought BNB with it. And we sent the BNB to SafePal, on BNB Smart Chain.

### How to swap BNB for BTCB and activate slot 1
Tutorial 3 of 3, the final step. Swap BNB for BTCB in SafePal, sign up with the link of the person who invited you, and activate slot 1 with two confirmations. Then see how to get back into your dashboard, any time.

Hi, my name is MTG, Your Digital Architect. Thank you for taking the time to watch this video.
In this video, I'll show you how to swap your BNB for BTCB, sign up with the link of the person who invited you, and activate slot 1. Then I'll show you how to get back into your dashboard, any time. Take your time. You can pause any step and follow along with me.

##### Part 1 Swap BNB for BTCB
- 2 Tap BTCB, then Swap 0:40 Open SafePal. Bitcoin Wealth takes its entry in BTCB, so we swap some of our BNB for it. The easiest way: tap BTCB, then tap Swap.
- 3 Pay BNB, receive BTCB 0:50 At the top it says Pay, BNB. Below it says Receive, BTCB. Both are BEP20, on BNB Smart Chain.
- 4 Type 0.0011 0:59 Leo, the mascot: Look here, this one's important. Tap the Receive amount, and type 0.0011. That's a little more than the 0.001 you need, because the swap takes a small fee. SafePal works out the BNB for you. And always leave a little BNB in your wallet, for network fees.
- 5 Swap, then Confirm 1:16 Tap Swap, and check the details: the BNB you pay, the BTCB you get, and a small network fee. Tap Confirm, then enter your password, or use your fingerprint.
- 6 Success: BTCB arrived 1:27 Success. Back in the wallet, I have a little more than 0.001 BTCB, and some BNB left for fees.

##### Part 2 Sign up with your sponsor's link
- Ready to join? 1:37 Ready to join? If I invited you, go to mtgtribe.com/bw. If someone else invited you, use their link, so you join their team.
- 7 Copy the sign-up link 1:46 On my website, tap Copy Sign-Up Link. A window confirms it: sign-up link copied.
- 8 Explore, then the DApp Store 1:52 Back in SafePal, tap Explore, at the bottom. The first time, SafePal shows you a guide about DApps. Leo, the mascot: A DApp is an app that runs on the blockchain. Your wallet opens it. Tick, I know how to use DApps, and tap View DApp Store. Then tap the search bar at the top, and paste your link.
- 9 Choose BNB Chain 2:12 SafePal asks you to select a network. Bitcoin Wealth runs on BNB Chain, so tap BNB Chain. Read the security warning, and tap Confirm.
- 10 Check the referrer 2:21 This is the registration page. Your wallet is connected. Activation: 0.001 BTC. Your balance. And the referrer: the member ID of the person who invited you. Leo, the mascot: Double check this. If that number is right, tap Proceed registration.

##### Part 3 Activate slot 1
- 11 1 of 2: Approve 2:42 Your wallet now asks you twice. First, Approve. It lets Bitcoin Wealth take exactly 0.001 BTCB. You can see the network fee, and your wallet's name. Tap Confirm.
- 12 2 of 2: Confirm again 2:55 The page says Working. Now the second one. It shows 0.001 BTCB leaving your wallet, and the fee. Tap Confirm again.
- 13 Wait for the blockchain 3:05 Now wait. The blockchain is confirming your registration. It can take a minute, so don't close the page.
- 14 Registration complete 3:10 Registration complete. Slot one is active. This is your member summary: your display name, your member ID, and 0 partners, because this account is brand new. And the 0.001 is a once-off. You never pay again to move up to the next slots.
- 15 Your own invitation link 3:25 Tap Go to dashboard. Here is your own invitation link. Tap Copy. That's the link you share with the people you invite.
- For builders: a website like this one 3:33 Builders, a website like this one, with your own name and your links, does the explaining for you. BW stands for Bitcoin Wealth, and you can order yours at mtgtribe.com/bwcopy.
- 16 Your own copy of this website 3:44 Order your copy, send me your invitation link, and I'll build it in. Owners also get the traffic source I use, so you can build your team in any country.
- 17 Look around your dashboard 3:53 Take a look around your Bitcoin Wealth dashboard: your slots, your partners, your team, and your transactions.
- Live on Zoom 3:59 We meet live on Zoom 5 evenings a week, in 4 languages. Ask the person who invited you to add you to the WhatsApp group, or tap the WhatsApp button below this video.
- 18 Back to your wallet 4:09 To go back to your wallet, tap the close button at the top right, then Back, then Wallet. I still have a little BNB for fees, and a little BTCB. I'm leaving it there. We collect Bitcoin, together.

##### Part 4 Get back into your dashboard, any time
- 19 Explore, then vowu.io 4:24 Bitcoin Wealth is a smart contract on BNB Chain, so you always open it through your Web3 wallet. Leo, the mascot: A Web3 wallet is an app where you hold your own crypto, with your own keys. SafePal is one. In SafePal, tap Explore, then the search bar. Type vowu.io, tap Go, choose BNB Chain, and tap Confirm.
- 20 Sign & Continue 4:46 Welcome back. Tap Sign & Continue, confirm in your wallet, and you're in.
- 21 Next time: search history 4:51 Next time, it's even quicker. Explore, search, and tap vowu.io in your search history.

##### Chapter 1 · 0:00 Is Bitcoin Wealth a coin?
Thandi: Leo, everybody keeps talking about Bitcoin Wealth. Is it a coin? Can I buy it?

##### Chapter 2 · 0:15 What is Bitcoin?
Thandi: Okay. Then start at the beginning. What is Bitcoin?
Leo: Bitcoin is digital money that no bank controls.
Leo: It started in 2009, and only 21 million will ever exist. That's why people call it digital gold.

##### Chapter 3 · 0:31 The stokvel, the tin and the book
Thandi: So where does Bitcoin Wealth come in?
Leo: You know a stokvel. People put money together, a treasurer holds it, and she keeps the book.
Thandi: And everybody prays she's honest!

##### Chapter 4 · 0:45 Not a coin: a smart contract
Leo: Exactly. Bitcoin Wealth is not a coin. It's a smart contract.
Leo: A program on the blockchain that follows fixed rules. When a member pays for a slot, the program sends that payment straight to other members' own wallets. And the book is open for anyone to read.

##### Chapter 5 · 1:03 BTCB and BNB, in plain words
Thandi: And it pays in real Bitcoin?
Leo: It pays in BTCB. That's Bitcoin's value on BNB Smart Chain. One BTCB tracks one Bitcoin, and you can swap it for Bitcoin.
Thandi: And BNB? I keep hearing BNB.
Leo: BNB pays the network fee. It's the postage stamp. No stamp, nothing moves.

##### Chapter 6 · 1:25 Where does the money come from?
Thandi: Now be straight with me, Leo. Where does the money come from?
Leo: From members. Every payout is another member's slot payment, passed on by the program.
Leo: No trading. No mining. So it grows when the community grows, and nothing is guaranteed.
Thandi: And what does it cost to start?
Leo: One entry. 0.001 Bitcoin, once.

##### Chapter 7 · 1:50 Check it yourself, then say it back
Thandi: And I must just take your word for it?
Leo: Never. Every payment is public. You can check it yourself, any time.
Thandi: So let me say it back. Bitcoin is the money. Bitcoin Wealth is the program that passes it on, wallet to wallet.
Thandi: BTCB is Bitcoin's value on BNB Smart Chain. And BNB is the stamp.
Leo: That's it! You've got it. And that's how we learn best: by teaching others.

##### Chapter 8 · 2:22 Your next step
Leo: This is education, not financial advice. So take your time, and do your own research.
Thandi: What's next, Leo?
Leo: Next: how the 14 positions pay.
Leo: And when you're ready to start, every step is at mtgtribe.com/bw.

## How Bitcoin Wealth pays: the 14 positions explained in 3 minutes

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/explainers/how-the-14-positions-pay-video/

Where do the 14 payments of a Bitcoin Wealth cycle go? Thandi asks, Leo shows it seat by seat: Royal Pool, spillover, no withdraw button. Every word written.

### How Bitcoin Wealth pays: the 14 positions, explained in 3 minutes
Explainer 2 of the Thandi and Leo series. Thandi asks who pays who, and Leo fills 14 seats with her, row by row, so she sees where every single payment goes. Watch it, then read every word below.

#### Watch the video
- Video: Explainer 2, "How the 14 positions pay" (3:19): Thandi asks, Leo draws it out seat by seat: 2, then 4, then 8 positions under you, where each of the 14 payments goes, the Royal Pool from your second cycle, who fills the seats, and why there is no withdraw button. https://media.bitcoinwealthpays.com/videos/how-bitcoin-wealth-pays-14-positions-explained.mp4 Its own page, with every word in writing: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/explainers/how-the-14-positions-pay-video/

It plays right here, in the laptop frame, and closes itself at the end. Tap a chapter below to watch just that part.
Invited by someone else? Join with their link, so they stay your sponsor.

#### Every word, chapter by chapter
Tap a time to start the video at that part.

##### Chapter 1 · 0:00 Who pays who? 14 seats, 14 payments
Thandi: Leo, you said every payout is another member's slot payment. So who pays who?
Leo: Picture 14 seats. Fill them with me, and you'll see where every single payment goes.
Thandi: 14 seats? Where are they?
Leo: Below you sit 2 seats, then 4, then 8. 14 in all. Each seat is one member paying the slot price, and each seat makes one payment.

##### Chapter 2 · 0:27 Where each of the 14 payments goes
Thandi: Okay. So where does each payment go?
Leo: Row 1. Seats 1 and 2 pay your upline, the two members above you.
Leo: Row 2. Seats 3 and 6 go straight to your wallet. Seats 4 and 5 buy your next slot.
Leo: Row 3. Seats 8, 9, 11 and 12 go to your wallet too. 7, 10 and 13 go to members below you. And seat 14 puts you back into the same slot, so it can fill again.

##### Chapter 3 · 0:55 9 of 14 point to you
Thandi: Wait. So how many of the 14 come to me?
Leo: Nine. 6 to your wallet, 2 buy your next slot, and 1 starts you again.
Thandi: And the other five?
Leo: 2 go up, to your upline. 3 go down, to members below you. The same rules, for every member.

##### Chapter 4 · 1:14 From your second cycle: the Royal Pool
Thandi: And when seat 14 starts me again?
Leo: From your second cycle in a slot, seat 4 goes to the Royal Pool and seat 5 goes to your wallet. So 7 to your wallet. Your next slot is already bought.

##### Chapter 5 · 1:27 Who fills the seats? Spillover
Thandi: Okay, Leo, honestly. Who fills all these seats?
Leo: Members. The people you introduce, and sometimes people from your upline's team, when it overflows. That's called spillover.
Leo: But every seat needs a real member. Nothing fills by itself, and nothing is guaranteed. That's why sharing and teaching matter.

##### Chapter 6 · 1:49 No withdraw button
Thandi: And I don't have to ask anyone for my payment?
Leo: No. There's no withdraw button. The contract splits each payment and sends it straight to members' own wallets, in the same transaction.

##### Chapter 7 · 2:01 Thandi says it back
Thandi: Let me say it back. 2, 4, 8: 14 seats, 14 payments. 2 go up, 3 go down. 6 to my wallet, 2 buy my next slot, and 1 starts me again.

##### Chapter 8 · 2:14 Your next step
Leo: That's it! You've got it. And that's how we learn best: by teaching others.
Leo: This is education, not financial advice. So take your time, and do your own research.
Thandi: What's next, Leo?
Leo: Next: the 12 slots, and why you only pay once.
Leo: And when you're ready to start, every step is at mtgtribe.com/bw.
Thandi: See you there!
Leo: If you want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together.
Leo: Thank you for watching. Take good care of yourself, and of the people you love. We can't wait to welcome you. Goodbye for now.

## Bitcoin Wealth vs a stokvel: 6 questions, side by side, in 4 minutes

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/explainers/better-than-a-stokvel-video/

Is Bitcoin Wealth just a stokvel online? Thandi asks 6 honest questions, Leo answers side by side and shows where the picture stops. Every word written.

### Bitcoin Wealth vs a stokvel: 6 questions, side by side, explained in 4 minutes
Explainer 4 of the Thandi and Leo series. Thandi asks if Bitcoin Wealth is just a stokvel on the internet, and Leo answers six honest questions side by side, and shows where the stokvel picture stops. Watch it, then read every word below.

#### Watch the video
- Video: Explainer 4, "Better than a stokvel?" (3:56): Thandi asks if Bitcoin Wealth is just a stokvel on the internet, and Leo answers six honest questions side by side: who holds the money, who can see the payments, the fees, what it pays in, how much you put in, and whether your turn is guaranteed. https://media.bitcoinwealthpays.com/videos/bitcoin-wealth-vs-stokvel-6-questions-side-by-side.mp4 Its own page, with every word in writing: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/explainers/better-than-a-stokvel-video/

#### In this video
- How a stokvel works: the tin, the treasurer, the book, the pot
- Who holds the money, and what peer to peer means
- Can you see every payment: the open book on BscScan
- Fees, what it pays in, and how much you put in
- Is your turn guaranteed: where the stokvel picture stops
It plays right here, in the laptop frame, and closes itself at the end. Tap a chapter below to watch just that part.
Invited by someone else? Join with their link, so they stay your sponsor.

#### Every word, chapter by chapter
Tap a time to start the video at that part.

##### Chapter 1 · 0:00 Is it just a stokvel on the internet?
Thandi: Leo, my mom's stokvel has paid out for 20 years. Is Bitcoin Wealth just a stokvel on the internet?
Leo: In some ways, it's better. In one big way, it's different. Welcome back, family, and well done for coming back to learn. Today: 6 questions, side by side.

##### Chapter 2 · 0:20 How a stokvel works
Leo: First, the stokvel. Every month, the members put in the same amount. The treasurer keeps the money in the tin, and writes it all in the book. And each month, one member takes the pot home, until everyone has had a turn.

##### Chapter 3 · 0:35 Question 1: who holds the money?
Thandi: And in Bitcoin Wealth? Who holds the money?
Leo: No treasurer, and no tin. That's the first big difference.
Leo: When a member pays for a slot, the smart contract passes the payment straight on, to other members' own wallets. Only the Royal Pool waits in the contract. That's called peer to peer: from one member, straight to another.

##### Chapter 4 · 0:58 Question 2: can you see every payment?
Thandi: And in my mom's stokvel, I only see the book when the treasurer shows it.
Leo: Here, the book is open to everyone, forever. You read it on BscScan.
Leo: Every activation and every payout since April 2026 is a public record. Picture a stokvel with over 41,000 member IDs, where anyone can check every single payment, from a phone.
Thandi: So no more praying the treasurer is honest!

##### Chapter 5 · 1:29 Questions 3 to 5: fees, what it pays in, how much
Leo: Three more, quickly. There's no bank in the middle, so no bank charges: only small network fees in BNB. A stokvel pays in rand. Bitcoin Wealth pays in BTCB, Bitcoin's value, and Bitcoin's price moves up and down. And a stokvel asks you to pay in every month, for the whole cycle.
Thandi: And Bitcoin Wealth? Every month too?
Leo: One entry. 0.001 Bitcoin, once.

##### Chapter 6 · 1:59 Question 6: is your turn guaranteed?
Thandi: Okay, Leo, be straight with me. In my mom's stokvel, everyone gets a turn. Is my turn guaranteed here?
Leo: No. And this is where the stokvel picture stops. A stokvel is a closed circle: the same members keep paying, so every turn comes around.
Leo: Bitcoin Wealth is an open circle. Your cycle fills only when real members activate the positions below you. So it grows as the community grows, and nothing is guaranteed.

##### Chapter 7 · 2:30 Thandi says it back
Thandi: So that's why teaching others matters!
Thandi: Let me say it back. No treasurer: payments go wallet to wallet. The book is open on BscScan. No bank charges, and one entry, once. But it's open: my cycle fills only when real members join below me.

##### Chapter 8 · 2:49 Your next step
Leo: That's it! You've got it. And that's how we learn best: by teaching others.
Leo: This is education, not financial advice. So take your time, and do your own research.
Thandi: What's next, Leo?
Leo: Next: the open book. I'll show you how to check it yourself, on BscScan.
Leo: And when you're ready to start, every step is at mtgtribe.com/bw.
Thandi: See you there!
Leo: If you want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together.
Leo: Thank you for watching. Take good care of yourself, and of the people you love. We can't wait to welcome you. Goodbye for now.

## Bitcoin Halving Countdown: live block height

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/tools/halving-countdown/

Live Bitcoin halving countdown: the current block height, blocks left to block 1,050,000 and an estimated date, explained in plain words.

### Bitcoin Halving Countdown
About every four years, the reward for mining a new Bitcoin block is cut in half. Here's how close the next one is, live.
Estimated: 2028
Reading the live block height…

#### About the halving

##### Why it matters
Fewer new Bitcoin are made after each halving, while the 21 million limit never changes. Past halvings were followed by big price moves, up and down. That's history, not a promise.

##### How it's estimated
A new block arrives about every 10 minutes on average, so the date is an estimate. The block number, 1,050,000, is exact. The reward drops from 3.125 to 1.5625 BTC per block.

## Bitcoin Wealth FAQ: straight answers

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/faq/

Straight answers about Bitcoin Wealth: costs, BTCB, fees, auto entry, the Royal Pool, safety, the admin controls and what happens if growth stops.

### Bitcoin Wealth FAQ: straight answers
The questions people ask most, answered plainly. Can't find yours? Ask in the MTG TRIBE.

#### Before you join
A smart contract on BNB Smart Chain where members activate slots with BTCB, and each payment goes straight to other members' wallets by fixed rules.
Slot 1 costs 0.001 BTC (paid as BTCB), plus small network fees in BNB. It's a once-off: slots 2 to 12 are bought automatically from the cycle below, once it fills.
No. Every payout comes from another member's slot payment. If new activations slow down, payouts slow down. Only use money you can afford to lose.
In three stages, all on your phone: set up a SafePal wallet, buy BNB with rand on VALR or Binance and send it to SafePal, then swap it to BTCB and activate slot 1 with the link of the person who invited you. Three tutorial videos show every tap, and each has its steps in writing.
By the plan's rules, when the 14 positions below you fill, six of those payments land in your own wallet as BTCB (Bitcoin's value on BNB Smart Chain), two buy your next slot and one recycles you. Every payment comes from another member activating a slot, so it depends on those positions filling: nothing is guaranteed.
Sponsoring two people is the first qualifier (Ignite) and switches on spillover. There's no upper limit, and nobody should ever be pressured.

#### Money and wallets
The contract runs on BNB Smart Chain, which can run smart contracts. BTCB is Bitcoin's value on that chain, backed one to one by Bitcoin held by Binance.
Every transaction on BNB Smart Chain pays a small fee in BNB. Without BNB nothing moves, even with plenty of BTCB in your wallet.
Payouts land in your own wallet in the same transaction as the activation that triggers them. There is no withdraw button and nobody to ask.
On VALR or Binance. Buy BNB, send it to SafePal on BNB Smart Chain (BEP20), then swap most of it to BTCB in SafePal.

#### Trust and safety
Yes. Paste the contract address into bscscan.com and look at the transactions. The Check it yourself page shows you how, step by step.
Yes. The contract has an owner wallet that can switch on an emergency mode and withdraw tokens the contract holds, among other settings. It is not renounced. We show this openly so you can judge for yourself.
No. It's MTG's independent guide. MTG is a member, and the sign-up button carries his referral link.

## Bitcoin Wealth glossary: crypto words in plain English

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/glossary/

Bitcoin, BTCB, BNB, smart contract, slot, recycle, BscScan and more: Bitcoin Wealth words explained in plain English with everyday examples.

### Glossary: crypto words in plain English
Every word you'll hear in the videos and pages, with an everyday example where it helps.

#### All the words

##### Bitcoin (BTC)
Digital money with no bank behind it, live since 2009. Only 21 million will ever exist.
Like: Digital gold: scarce, and nobody can print more.

##### Satoshi
The smallest piece of a Bitcoin: one hundred millionth. 0.001 BTC is 100,000 satoshis.
Like: Cents in a rand, but much smaller.

##### BTCB
Bitcoin's value on BNB Smart Chain, issued by Binance and backed one to one by Bitcoin it holds.
Like: A voucher you can swap back for the real thing.

##### BNB
The coin that pays network fees on BNB Smart Chain.
Like: The postage stamp on every letter you send.

##### BNB Smart Chain (BEP20)
The blockchain Bitcoin Wealth runs on. BEP20 is the name for tokens on it.
Like: The road the delivery truck drives on.

##### Smart contract
A program on the blockchain that runs its rules automatically, the same way for everyone.
Like: A vending machine: the right coin in, the snack out, no shopkeeper.

##### Web3 wallet
An app like SafePal or MetaMask that holds the keys to your crypto. You own it, not a company.
Like: Your own house keys.

##### Recovery phrase
The 12 secret words that can restore your wallet on any phone. Never share them.
Like: The master key to your house. Never give out a copy.

##### Slot
One of 12 levels in Bitcoin Wealth, from 0.001 BTC to 2.048 BTC.
Like: Floors in a building: each one costs double the one below.

##### Position
One of the 14 seats below you in a cycle: 2, then 4, then 8.
Like: Seats on a bus that fill as people board.

##### Cycle
One round of 14 filled positions at a slot.
Like: One full bus trip.

##### Recycle
When a cycle completes, one payment puts you back into the same slot so it can pay again.
Like: Buying the next bus ticket from this trip's fares.

##### Auto entry
Slots 2 to 12 are bought for you with two payments from your first cycle at the slot below.
Like: A free upgrade, earned by filling the bus below.

##### Spillover
When your upline's team overflows, new members can land in positions below you.
Like: Extra passengers sent to your bus when the one ahead is full.

##### Royal Pool
In later cycles one payment goes to a pool shared monthly by members who reach slot 3 and qualify.

##### BscScan
The public website where anyone can look up BNB Smart Chain addresses and transactions.
Like: A public bank statement everyone can read.

##### Token approval
Permission you give a contract to move a token from your wallet. Approve only what you need.
Like: Signing a debit order: check the amount.

##### Gas (network fee)
The small fee in BNB paid for every transaction on BNB Smart Chain.

##### Halving
About every four years, the reward for mining new Bitcoin is cut in half.

##### Renounced
A contract whose owner has given up control for good. Bitcoin Wealth's contract is not renounced.

## Bitcoin Wealth safety centre: protect your wallet

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/bw/dashboard/safety/

Protect your wallet while you use Bitcoin Wealth: your recovery phrase, token approvals, the right network, scam patterns and safe habits.

### Bitcoin Wealth safety centre
Six habits that protect your wallet, whatever you use it for.

#### Six safety habits

##### Never share your recovery phrase
Nobody genuine will ever ask for it: not MTG, not support, not a "recovery service". Write it on paper, offline.

##### Approve only the exact amount
When SafePal asks to approve BTCB, approve only what you're paying. Review old approvals now and then.

##### Right network, small test first
Send on BNB Smart Chain (BEP20). Send a small test amount first, then the rest.

##### Keep some BNB
Never empty your BNB, or you won't be able to move anything.

##### Type addresses yourself
Download apps from official websites, and type bscscan.com yourself rather than clicking links in messages.

##### Hide before you share
Cover addresses, balances and emails before you post a screenshot.

#### Scam patterns

##### Walk away if someone
- Asks for your recovery phrase or a screenshot of it
- Promises a fixed daily or weekly return
- Pressures you to decide today
- Asks you to send crypto to unlock a payout

##### Learn more, free
MTG's Crypto 101 crash course covers wallets, scams, wallet drainers and token approvals in 15 short lessons.
